summary: Langflow before 1.3.0 executes unauthenticated code via its validation endpoint
details:
Langflow before 1.3.0 exposes a code-validation endpoint that executes submitted Python without authentication. Any instance reachable by an attacker is fully compromised. An instance bound to the local machine only is not remotely reachable.

NOTE: this OSV record over-matches. The source advisory is affected only under conditions OSV cannot express (see affected[].database_specific); a plain version match here flags deployments that are not actually affected.
